polishes.name: Ridge Filling Basecoat
polishes.description: Provides ridge relief from uneven nail surfaces! Start with a smooth surface under your manicures for a flawless effect. What does this product do?It evens out the surface of the nail plate, making a smooth surface to apply any polish over. Any ridges or bumps in our nails are filled in and even. Number of coats: 2 thin layersDry time - 2-3 mins each layer ingredients: Butyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Acetyl Tributyl Citrate, Adipic Acid / Neopentyl Gycol / Trimellitic Anhydride Copolymer, Isopropyl Alcohol, Acrylates Copolymer, Stearalkonium Bentonite, Styrene / Acrylates Copolymer, Polyvinyl Butyral, Benzophenone-1, Titanium Dioxide

polishes.name: Sticky Basecoat
polishes.description: What does it do: it's sticky, long-lasting and stain preventing! *products color can vary from a green tone to a blue shade, various shade ranges are possible, it’s merely color tinting of the product that varies batch to batch, it does not affect the base coat’s quality or performance* Allow the base coat to fully dry for approximately 3-5 minutes then apply your favorite nail lacquer! ingredients: Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Acetyl Tributyl Citrate, Isopropyl Alcohol, Adipic Acid / Neopentyl Glycol / Trimellitic Anhydride Copolymer, Benzophenone-3,Trimethylpentanediyl Dibenzoate, Polyvinyl Butyral, D&C Yellow #11, FD&C Blue #1

polishes.name: Topcoat
polishes.description: Clear, shiny and fast drying! Achieve intense shine with this crystal clear formula. Allow all layers of polish to fully dry before applying this quick-drying topcoat for best results. 2-4 minutes or less and your nails will be dry, durable, long lasting with days of no tip wear, chipping! Apply Glisten & Glow top coat in a thin layer floating it over the top of the polish below. Seal the tips, side walls and just past the colored polish line near your cuticle to prevent any shrinkage. Want to intensify your holographic polishes? Add a coat of Glisten & Glow top coat! Glisten & Glow top coat has an even consistency throughout the whole bottle, but if yours does get a little thick or gloppy just add a few drops of nail polish thinner and roll between your hands. Don't worry it's just restoring some of the solvents that are already in it, that have evaporated since its been opened. Glisten & Glow Top Coat is a 2 free product. It does NOT contain DBP, Camphor, formaldehyde, or formaldehyde resin. It does contain Toulene. Top Coat ingredients are: Butyl Acetate, toluene, ethyl acetate, alcohol, acrylate co polymer, butyl bezyl, phthalate, nitrocellulose, and benzophenone
